feature: Add Getting Started Tutorial for New Users
workflow_rationale: This is a straightforward documentation task - creating a single tutorial file to help new restaurant owners understand the complete workflow from registration to QR code download. No code changes, single service (documentation), low complexity.

phases.name: Create Getting Started Tutorial
phases.description: Write comprehensive beginner-friendly tutorial in Turkish for restaurant owners

subtasks.description: Create BASLANGIC_REHBERI.md with complete tutorial content
